description: Default policy: which agent may call which tool, which calls wait for a person, and how much an agent task may spend. Agents can read the policy; only an admin can change it, and every change is a new version.

outbound.note: Hosts this machine may send data to: null for any, [] for none, or a list such as ["api.anthropic.com", "*.huggingface.co"]. Every outbound call is recorded either way.

registry.note: true: a model version must be signed off by someone other than the person who proposed it (four eyes).

min_model_b.note: Smallest model, in billions of parameters, that may drive an agent. 3 from 20 tool-use tasks (0.5B 13, 1.5B 15, 3B 17, 7B 18 right). The answer agent needs 7: on the policies suite a 3B agent got 16 of 18 against 18 for the fixed workflow, a 7B 18.
